name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The if-sentence gives RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) because 'also' is a no-timing cue. The Then-sentence gives hard Existence(target_picked_up), Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) and Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up). Each clause traces to the task, no Existence is added for the key because the chain forces it, and the redundancy note on RespondedExistence concerns an if rule the task states, so it stays.

texts: If the agent moves the ball (blocker_moved) at any point, it must also take the key (has_door_key) at some point, before, with, or after that move.
The agent must pick up the box in the other room (target_picked_up) at some point.
The box pickup must come after the key is taken: target_picked_up must not happen before has_door_key has happened.
Whenever the ball has been moved (blocker_moved), the box must be picked up on that step or later.
